text:
Maria (ml-eng): Starting intake for Orpheus-6B bring-up. Quick ask: license looks permissive but has a clause about commercial redistribution. Need legal + compliance review before hosting. Also planning 4-bit quant experiments and evals on summarization + codegen. TL;DR: can we host on Hosted API or only Dedicated/Private?
Sam (legal): Can you paste the exact clause? quick read: if weights can't be redistributed we probably can't offer model download, but hosting as-a-service may still be restricted depending on wording. Pinging @ComplianceBot.
Maria (ml-eng): Snippet below:
```
LICENSE — Section 3b:
"Redistribution of trained weights for commercial purposes is prohibited. Research and non-commercial use is allowed with attribution."
```
Sam (legal): That reads like a non-commercial clause. If it truly forbids commercial hosting we can't put it on Hosted API (paid). Need full LICENSE file + provenance. Also flag export control if training data includes restricted sources.
Dmitri (infra): We can technically block downloads and geo-fence, but legal constraints override. For Private/VPC it's fine. We could implement an enterprise-only workflow (Dedicated) while legal negotiates.
Renee (product): What are the immediate implications for prioritization? Should we pause quant/bench until legal confirms, or run internal evals only?
Lee (evals): I can run quant and perf comparisons on internal infra (no external exposure). Plan: baseline float16 vs 4-bit AWQ. Tests: CNN-DM summarization, HumanEval for code, and a small chat-safety probe set. Expect some degradation but we'll quantify.
ComplianceBot: LICENSE_SCANNER: Detected token "non-commercial" in LICENSE file. RISK_LEVEL=RESTRICTED. RECOMMENDED_ACTION=BLOCK_HOSTED_API; ALLOW_PRIVATE. Details: /licenses/scan/1855006789
Sam (legal): Ok — block hosted for now. Maria, please mark 'hostable: no' in the intake doc and set deployment options to Dedicated/Private only. Also add an export-control checkbox: was model trained on any non-public EU gov data?
Maria (ml-eng): Will update intake draft: https://redwood.internal/onboard/orpheus-6b (draft). I'll also do local quant runs with `./run_eval.sh --model orpheus-6b --quantize 4bit --backend awq` and share logs. Artifacts will be internal-only until legal clears.
Dmitri (infra): When you share artifacts tag them `no-host`. I can prepare a Dedicated-only canary config but deploy-bot: canary action should be blocked until legal clearance.
deploy-bot: ACTION BLOCKED — License restriction prevents Hosted API canary. Please obtain legal clearance.
Renee (product): :thumbsup: Good plan. Prioritize legal + export control checks, then run evals. If legal negotiates a commercial license later, we can re-evaluate hosting.
Lee (evals): Running tests now, will post a short summary by EOD. Quick note: expect ~5-10% ROUGE drop with 4-bit quant on summarization; will include pass@1 delta for HumanEval.
Maria (ml-eng): Thanks all. Tagging @Sam for final sign-off when you have the license verdict. I'll set intake priority to "medium" and schedule quant experiments on internal runners.
Sam (legal): On it. If provider is open to a commercial addendum we may request a CLARIFIED license or CLA. I'll update thread with next steps.
